palette.name: Colours
palette.mode_info: Dark turns the whole shop over: every colour scheme swaps its ground and its text, and the accent is lifted so it still carries. The colours below stay exactly as you set them — this chooses which way up they are used.
palette.surface_info: Fills image frames, the newsletter panel and empty states.
palette.accent_info: The full light-to-dark ramp is generated from this one colour.
palette.accent_2_info: Used sparingly — new badges, the free-shipping bar and in-stock marks.
palette.button_info: The solid buttons — add to bag, checkout, the hero call to action.

typography.name: Typography
typography.heading_font_info: Set both to the same family for the flush, single-typeface look of the original design.
typography.accent_font_info: A third font any individual heading, label or paragraph can be switched to. Leave it matching the others unless you want a deliberate contrast.
typography.heading_weight_info: Weight of the largest headings. 300 gives the light, wide-set look; 500 reads bolder.
typography.tracking_info: Negative values tighten large headings. Measured in thousandths of an em.

layout.name: Layout
layout.corner_radius_info: Applies to image frames and panels. Buttons and chips stay fully rounded.

motion.name: Motion
motion.reduced_motion_note: Every animation here is disabled automatically for visitors who ask their device to reduce motion.
motion.reveal_info: Sections fade and rise into place as they enter the viewport.
motion.kenburns_info: Slowly scales the hero image for a subtle sense of movement.
motion.parallax_info: Shifts the editorial image against the scroll.

product_card.name: Product cards
product_card.quick_add_info: Shown on hover. Products with options link to the product page instead of adding blind.
product_card.wishlist_info: Saves to the visitor's browser — no account needed.
product_card.swatches_info: Reads the product's colour option, using swatch values where you have set them.
product_card.subtitle: Card subtitle

cart.name: Bag
cart.threshold_info: In your store's currency, without a symbol. For example 150.
cart.checkout_mode_info: Applies to Checkout in the bag and Buy it now on the product page.
cart.checkout_url_info: Used when the buy buttons point at your own order form. Pick the page your order form app created, or paste its address. Shoppers go straight there instead of to Shopify checkout, so the app collects their details rather than Shopify.

brand.name: Brand
brand.share_image_info: Used when a link to your store is shared and the page has no image of its own.
